request.prompt:
Implement the following change to the application so that it fully satisfies
the specification and all existing and new tests pass. Run the test suite and
make it green before finishing.

Reject creating an owner when another owner already has the same last name and the same telephone number. Respond with 409.

agent.result_text:
Full suite is green: **257 tests, 0 failures**.

## Summary

The `POST /api/owners` pipeline already had a `rejectDuplicate` step, but its `RejectDuplicateOwner` function rejected only when *all* fields (first name, last name, address, city, telephone) matched. The new spec requires rejecting on **same last name + same telephone**.

Changes:

1. **`RejectDuplicateOwner.java`** — narrowed the duplicate check to match on last name and telephone only. It queries `findByLastName` (a `LIKE prefix` match) and throws the checked `ConflictException` (→ 409 via the existing escalation handler) when an existing owner shares both the exact last name and telephone. Added an explicit `getLastName()` equality guard so the repository's prefix-match semantics can't cause a false positive on a different last name.

2. **`OwnerRestControllerV1Tests.createOwnerSuccess`** — this existing test built a new "George Franklin" reusing the seed owner's telephone `6085551023`, relying on the old all-fields semantics (distinct address made it non-duplicate). Under the new rule that's a genuine conflict, so I gave the created owner a distinct telephone (`6085559999`) so it correctly exercises a successful, non-conflicting creation.

The new `Cp02Tests` (reject same last name + telephone → 409; allow same last name + different telephone → 2xx) pass, and no other tests regressed.
